reason: A client-side DSH web plugin that localizes selected interface labels and permission displays into Chinese, with read-only detection of official adaptations and fixed-size local state.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH Web 界面中的指定命令、权限预设和推理等级显示为中文，并检测官方适配状态。
summaries.en: Localizes selected DSH web interface labels, permission presets, and reasoning levels into Chinese while checking for official localization updates.

capabilities: Translates specified DSH web interface labels into Chinese
Changes the display color of the Full access permission option
Restores a reduced-motion shimmer animation for a specified status container
Performs three read-only host RPC probes to detect official localization changes
Stores two fixed localStorage keys for enablement and probe state
Displays a one-time adaptation notice in the page UI
